sop_name: ISO 15118-2 TTCN-3 Test Code Generation SOP
description: Standard Operating Procedures for generating TTCN-3 conformance test code from ISO 15118-2 test cases. Uses a 5-Agent architecture (Orchestrator, Summarizer, Core Agent, Fault Corrector, Infrastructure Agent) with iterative validation, cross-platform build/run, and dual-track runtime analysis.

1.0_to_1.1: Upgraded from 4-Agent to 5-Agent architecture (added Summarizer, Infrastructure Agent)
Added iteration loops (small static loop, large compile loop, large runtime loop)
Added Infrastructure Agent section (TITAN project generation, 26-28 files)
Added Build & Run section (cross-platform, optional PCAP capture)
Expanded precondition_chains with 7 missing message types
Added compile error classifier patterns to common_errors
Added timer naming rules and timer_param naming rules
Added module naming rule and output structure section
Updated naming convention for receive_template pattern

overview.input: Structured test case JSON (from test_case_generator.py, Phase 1)
overview.output: Complete TTCN-3 code module + optional TITAN project structure

agents.orchestrator: Intent decomposition: test case JSON to TTCN-3 generation plan
agents.summarizer: Knowledge retrieval: select most relevant TTCN-3 code from knowledge base
agents.core_agent: TTCN-3 code generation: generate complete module
agents.fault_corrector: Validation and repair: static/compile/runtime three-phase correction
agents.infrastructure_agent: Project scaffolding: generate complete TITAN project structure

phase_summary.generation: Orchestrator → Summarizer → Core Agent → Fault Corrector (static, small loop)
phase_summary.runtime: Fault Corrector (compile) → Fault Corrector (runtime) → Self-Repair (large loops)

steps.name: Intent Decomposition (Orchestrator)
steps.description: Analyze the test case JSON and decompose it into a structured TTCN-3 generation plan
details: Identify SUT type (SECC or EVCC) from test case
Determine message type and protocol layer (V2GTP, SDP, V2G Application)
Identify test type (GoodCase or BadCase)
Determine required precondition chain from SOP
List required templates (send and receive)
Identify timer parameters from message type
Determine expected verdict logic
Extract naming convention from SOP

steps.name: Knowledge Retrieval (Summarizer)
steps.description: Retrieve the most relevant TTCN-3 reference code from the knowledge base
details: Use pre-filtered results from local search by message_type and sut_type
Select reference testcase matching tc_id pattern
Select reference test behavior function
Select relevant send/receive templates
Select relevant precondition/postcondition functions
Provide additional context about protocol-specific patterns

steps.name: TTCN-3 Code Generation (Core Agent)
steps.description: Generate the complete TTCN-3 module code
details: Function signature: f_{SUT}_{Category}_TB_VTB_{MessageType}_{SeqNo}
Generate send template (md_CMN_*) for request message
Generate receive/matching template (mdw_SECC_* or mdw_EVCC_*) for response
Use correct field types from ISO 15118-2 schema
Start appropriate timer
Implement alt block with alternatives: expected response (pass), unexpected response (fail), connection status change (for BadCase), timer timeout (inconc)
Stop timer in each non-timeout alternative
Set verdict with descriptive message
Return getverdict
Testcase signature: TC_{SUT}_{Category}_VTB_{MessageType}_{SeqNo}
Phase A+B: Call precondition function chain
Phase C: Check precondition verdict, call test behavior function
Phase D: Call postcondition function
Add @desc/@reference/@requirement documentation comments

steps.name: Static Validation (Fault Corrector, phase=static)
steps.description: Validate generated code with 8-item static checks; iterate up to 3 times
details: Check naming convention compliance (TC_*, f_*_TB_VTB_*, md_*, mdw_*)
Verify template parameter types match ISO 15118-2 schema
Ensure all alt branches set verdict
Verify timer start/stop pairs
Check port names match component definitions (pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port / pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_EVCC_Port)
Validate import statements
Verify runs on component type matches SUT (SECCTester / EVCCTester)
Check all alt branches stop timer (except timeout branch)
Fix common TTCN-3 syntax issues
8_static_checks: component_port: runs on / system / port name matches SUT type
timer_handling: Start/stop pairs, timeout branch does not call stop
verdict_logic: GoodCase/BadCase verdict conditions are correct
template_fields: send/receive template fields are correct

steps.name: Infrastructure Generation (Infrastructure Agent)
steps.description: Generate complete TITAN project structure (config, cpp_adapters, TTCN-3 skeleton, build script)
details: Generate config/titan_runtime.cfg with SUT IP configuration
Generate config/hardware_env.json
Generate src/cpp_adapters/ with TCI, TRI, EXI, Hardware adapters
Generate src/ttcn3/ skeleton modules (Types, Templates, PICS, PIXIT, Components, PreConditions, PostConditions)
Generate build.sh (Linux) and build.bat (Windows)
Place generated .ttcn in src/ttcn3/4_TestCases/
Create logs/ directory structure

steps.name: Build & Run (Pipeline)
steps.description: Compile and execute the TITAN test project; optionally capture PCAP during execution
steps.platform_detection: auto (Windows: cmd /c build.bat, Linux: bash build.sh)
details: Step 0: Check TITAN toolchain (makefilegen, ttcn3_compiler, ttcn3_executor)
Step 1: Detect platform and select build script
Step 2: Start optional PCAP sniffer (scapy-based, V2G_Sniffer)
Step 3: Execute build script, capture stdout/stderr
Step 4: Parse and classify compile errors
Step 5: If compile succeeds, run TestExecution with titan_runtime.cfg
Step 6: Stop sniffer, save capture.pcap
Save build.log to logs/system_logs/
Read TestExecution.log from logs/titan_traces/

steps.name: Compile Error Repair (Fault Corrector, phase=compile)
steps.description: Analyze TITAN compilation errors using knowledge base; fix and re-compile
details: Parse raw compiler output into structured error list
Classify each error using CompileErrorClassifier
Classify by pattern: port_undefined, import_missing, type_mismatch, runs_on_mismatch, timer_error, ttcn_syntax, cpp_link
Look up fix suggestion from titan_troubleshooting_db.json
Generate corrected code using LLM
Write fixed code to .ttcn file
Re-run build
Loop until compilation succeeds or max iterations reached

error_classifier_patterns.fix: Define port type in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn; match port name exactly
Add import from <module_name> all; at module top
Check template parameter types and function signatures
Ensure runs on component type matches caller; called function must use same or parent type
Ensure tc_X.start() is called before referencing timeout
Check TTCN-3 syntax: braces, semicolons, keywords; see TITAN ReferenceGuide Ch.3
Check C++ adapters in cpp_adapters/ for missing method implementations

steps.name: Runtime Analysis (Fault Corrector, phase=runtime)
steps.description: Dual-track root cause analysis using TTCN-3 log and PCAP capture
details: Track 1: Parse TTCN-3 TestExecution.log, extract verdict sequence, identify first failure
Track 2: Parse PCAP capture, reconstruct V2GTP message sequence
Cross-validate: Align TTCN-3 send events with PCAP packets, report divergence points
Correlate TTCN-3 timestamps with PCAP timestamps
Classify fault into 6 types: verdict_mismatch, timeout, protocol_error, timer_issue, assertion_failure, unknown
Generate repair suggestions using RepairEngine
Update titan_troubleshooting_db.json with new patterns (self-learning)

repair_types.auto_fix: Automatically apply suggested code replacement to source
repair_types.manual_review: Provide fix suggestion but do not auto-apply (complex semantic changes)

steps.name: Self-Repair (Pipeline)
steps.description: Automatically apply auto_fix repairs from Fault Corrector runtime phase; re-compile and validate
details: Filter repairs by type == 'auto_fix' with both current_code and suggested_code
Apply code replacements to ttcn3_code
Write updated code to both output path and project src/ttcn3/ path
Re-run build (Step 6)
If build succeeds: record repairs to knowledge base (learn_from_repair)
If build fails: rollback to original code, report repair failure
Max self-repair iterations: 2

iteration_loops.description: The pipeline uses three distinct iteration loops at different stages

small_loop.name: Static Validation Loop
small_loop.flow: Core Agent generates code → Fault Corrector (static) validates → If fail: feedback to Core Agent → Repeat
small_loop.exit_condition: Fault Corrector status == 'pass' or max iterations reached

large_loop_compile.name: Compile Error Repair Loop
large_loop_compile.flow: Build fails → Fault Corrector (compile) analyzes → Core Agent fixes → Re-build → Repeat

large_loop_runtime.name: Runtime Self-Repair Loop
large_loop_runtime.flow: Test executes with failure → Fault Corrector (runtime) dual-track analysis → Self-Repair applies fixes → Re-build+run → Repeat
large_loop_runtime.exit_condition: Test passes, max iterations reached, or fault type requires manual review

fault_corrector.description: Unified Fault Corrector covering three phases with a single entry point

static.trigger: After Core Agent generates code (no log files available)
dynamic_references: COMPILE_ERROR_URLS: TITAN reference guide URLs from doc_urls.json

compile.trigger: TITAN compilation failed (raw error output available)

runtime.trigger: TITAN test execution completed (log + optional PCAP available)
runtime.method: Dual-track analysis: TTCN-3 log + PCAP + Python correlator + LLM reasoning

python_components.correlator: Align TTCN-3 log events with PCAP packets by timestamp
python_components.fault_classifier: Classify fault into 6 types with confidence score
python_components.repair_engine: Generate repairs from classified fault + source code

module.note: Same as testcase name; module name must match the testcase ID

send_template.note: Common templates used by both SECC and EVCC tests

timer.note: Single timer instance per test behavior function

protocol_constants.note: 这些常量在 core_agent_prompt.txt、sop.json common_errors、repair_engine.py AUTO_FIX_RULES 中引用时请使用此处的定义

common_errors.error: Missing timer stop in alt branch
common_errors.fix: Add tc_*.stop before setverdict in every non-timeout alt branch

common_errors.error: Wrong port name for SUT type
common_errors.fix: SECC tests use pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port, EVCC tests use pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_EVCC_Port

common_errors.error: Missing return getverdict in test behavior function
common_errors.fix: Always end test behavior function with 'return getverdict;'

common_errors.error: Using 'omit' in receive template where '?' is needed
common_errors.fix: 'omit' means field must be absent; '?' means any value; '*' means optional (present or absent)

common_errors.error: Wrong component type in runs on clause
common_errors.fix: SECC tests: runs on SECCTester system SystemSECC; EVCC tests: runs on EVCCTester system SystemEVCC
V2GTP tests need SupportedAppProtocol precondition; V2G message tests need the full chain up to the target message

common_errors.error: Port type not defined in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn
common_errors.fix: Ensure port name used matches exactly with the declaration in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn. Port must be defined as: type port <Name> message { out ...; in ...; }
Add 'import from <module_name> all;' at the top of the module. Common imports: ISO15118_2_DataTypes, ISO15118_2_Templates

common_errors.error: runs on clause mismatch between testcase and function/altstep
common_errors.fix: All called functions and altsteps must use the same runs on component type as the testcase. If testcase runs on SECCTester, all functions must runs on SECCTester

common_errors.error: Timer referenced before start() is called
common_errors.fix: Ensure tc_X.start() is called before any timeout branch is reachable. Timer must be started before it can timeout

common_errors.error: C++ adapter method not implemented (undefined reference in linking)
common_errors.fix: Implement the corresponding method in the C++ adapter .cc file under src/cpp_adapters/. Check for duplicate definitions across multiple .cc files

common_errors.error: Template type mismatch (parameter count or type)
common_errors.fix: Ensure the template instantiation matches the template declaration exactly: same number of parameters, correct parameter types, matching optional/omit fields

common_errors.error: Alt block does not handle all port operations
common_errors.fix: Every send/receive/check operation on a port must be covered by a corresponding alt branch. TITAN flags incomplete alt blocks at compile time

precondition_chains.description: Precondition chain for each V2G message type. Each chain must be completed in order before testing the target message.

_missing_precondition_chains.description: Message types that are not standard V2G application layer messages but may appear in test cases. These do not require full precondition chains.

V2GTPHeader.description: V2GTP header structure tests - no protocol handshake needed
V2GTPHeader.note: V2GTP Header tests verify the V2GTP layer header format without requiring SupportedAppProtocol or SessionSetup

V2GTP_BR.description: V2GTP Basic Requirements tests - similar to V2GTPHeader
V2GTP_BR.note: V2GTP_BR tests the V2GTP entity behavior without full protocol sequence

V2GTP.description: V2GTP layer tests - only InitConfiguration needed

SDP.description: Service Discovery Protocol tests - only InitConfiguration needed

SDPProvider.description: SDP Provider tests - only InitConfiguration needed

TCP.description: TCP connection tests - no precondition needed
TCP.note: TCP connection tests verify basic TCP transport without V2GTP

TLSHandshake.description: TLS handshake tests - no precondition needed
TLSHandshake.note: TLS handshake tests verify TLS establishment without V2GTP

EVCCMessage.description: Generic EVCC message tests - fallback to SupportedAppProtocol

SECCMessage.description: Generic SECC message tests - fallback to SupportedAppProtocol

build_and_run.description: Cross-platform TITAN build and test execution

sniffer.captures: V2GTP messages on relevant network interface

build_statuses.completed: Build succeeded and test execution finished
build_statuses.build_success_no_executable: Compilation succeeded but TestExecutable not found
build_statuses.error: Toolchain not found or unexpected error

files.{tc_id}_fault_analysis.json: Runtime fault analysis result (if runtime phase was executed)

project_dir.description: Full TITAN project (generated when --with-infrastructure is used)

subdirs.src/ttcn3/: TTCN-3 source modules (Types, Templates, Components, Pre/PostConditions, TestCases)
